description: Licensed features: the token the check catalog gates on, the service plans that grant it, and what it unlocks. Detection (Get-PostureLicenseToken) and the licensing advisor read this file; nothing else holds plan names.

features.name: Microsoft Entra ID P1
features.what: Conditional Access, group-based licensing, dynamic groups, sign-in logs beyond 7 days.

features.name: Microsoft Entra ID P2
features.what: Risk-based Conditional Access, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management, access reviews.

features.name: Microsoft Entra ID Governance
features.what: Lifecycle workflows, entitlement management at scale, advanced access reviews.

features.name: Microsoft Entra Internet Access
features.what: Secure web gateway: web filtering and Conditional Access on internet traffic.

features.name: Microsoft Entra Private Access
features.what: Zero trust access to private apps without a VPN.

features.name: Microsoft Entra Workload ID
features.what: Conditional Access and risk detection for service principals.

features.name: Microsoft Intune Plan 1
features.what: Device enrollment, compliance, configuration, app protection.

features.name: Microsoft Intune Suite
features.what: Endpoint Privilege Management, Remote Help, advanced analytics, Tunnel for MAM.
features.note: The Intune Suite SKU carries these plans; each add-on sold alone carries one of them. Intune Plan 1 is a prerequisite, not part of the suite.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1
features.what: Next-generation antivirus, attack surface reduction, device control.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 2
features.what: EDR, automated investigation, vulnerability management, advanced hunting.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Business
features.what: EDR and automated investigation for up to 300 users.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1
features.what: Safe Links, Safe Attachments, anti-phishing impersonation protection.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2
features.what: Threat Explorer, automated investigation, attack simulation training.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Identity
features.what: Detects attacks on on-premises Active Directory.

features.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
features.what: Shadow IT discovery, session controls, app governance.

features.name: Purview Information Protection (standard)
features.what: Manual sensitivity labels with encryption.

features.name: Purview Information Protection (premium)
features.what: Automatic labelling, labelling at scale, content explorer.

features.name: Purview Endpoint DLP
features.what: Data loss prevention on Windows and macOS devices.

features.name: Purview DLP for Teams
features.what: Data loss prevention in Teams chats and channels.

features.name: Purview Audit (Premium)
features.what: One-year audit retention and the high-value events investigations need.

features.name: Purview Insider Risk Management
features.what: Policies for data theft by departing users and similar risks.

features.name: Purview eDiscovery (Premium)
features.what: Review sets, analytics and holds at scale.

features.name: Purview Communication Compliance
features.what: Policies over messages for regulatory and conduct risks.

features.name: Purview Information Barriers
features.what: Stops groups of users communicating where rules require it.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
features.what: Copilot in the Microsoft 365 apps and grounded on work data.

features.name: SharePoint Advanced Management
features.what: Data access governance reports, restricted access control, site access reviews.
features.note: (verify) No SharePoint Advanced Management service plan appears in Microsoft's list as of 2026-11-20; Microsoft 365 Copilot licences include it, so Copilot implies it. Add the plan name here once seen on a live tenant.
